name: Yokogawa CENTUM VP with ProSafe-RS

specifications.basis: Yokogawa General Specifications GS 33K01A10-50E, 12th Edition Sep. 1, 2014 (© 2011 Yokogawa), PDF read via r.jina.ai: 'Maximum 100000 per system (when LHS4000 is in use, up to 1000000 per system)'.
Yokogawa GS 33K01A10-50E, 12th Edition Sep. 1, 2014, read via r.jina.ai: 'Link transmission period: 100 ms'; Vnet/IP described as dual-redundant gigabit Ethernet control network.

Yokogawa GS 33K01A10-50E, 12th Edition Sep. 1, 2014, read via r.jina.ai: UGS standard functions list Modbus, EtherNet/IP, OPC DA and 'LBC1570 IEC 61850 IED Communication Package (for UGS)'. (value: LBC1570 IEC 61850 IED Communication Package (for UGS))

Yokogawa GS 33K01A10-50E, 12th Edition Sep. 1, 2014, read via r.jina.ai: 'ProSafe-RS has certified by Technische Überwachungs Verein (TÜV) as a safety system to satisfy safety integrity level (SIL) 3 of IEC 61508.' (value: TÜV certified SIL 3 of IEC 61508 (ProSafe-RS))

Yokogawa CENTUM VP product page, read directly: 'A high speed remote I/O unit enables connecting controllers over remote site up to 50 kilometers via optical fiber cables'; same figure appears as '50 km (with Optical ESB Bus Repeater Module)' in GS 33K01A10-50E (12th Ed., 2014).

notes: Product/catalogue record from a page read in the GEG plant WBS sweep.
